L5·N12221unmasked layer
This is predominantly a suppression neuron: its largest-magnitude (negative) responses land on the highly predictable second element of colloquial fixed phrases/idioms ("big wh**up**", "your **mileage** may vary", "fancy-sch**m**ancy", "gun **shy**"), while its weak positive activations occur on ordinary temporal/common nouns filling a slot after a determiner or preposition (" summer", " September", " UN", numeral "0", suffix "ers").
